verdict.rationale: The evidence documents programmatic APIs for payments, payouts, card issuing and accounts, plus SDKs, webhooks and a sandbox. Spend-management pages describe AI receipt capture and expense handling, but only as in-app features. Nothing shows a REST API endpoint for pulling transactions, expenses or receipts, and nothing mentions OAuth or scoped tokens. Accounting-software sync is an integration, not a developer API, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull transactions, expenses, and receipts through a documented REST API with OAuth and scoped tokens
